name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 29 – Am 18
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 29. Encourages Member States to support voluntary initiatives promoting responsible consumption, in line with national legislation; calls on the Member States to devise awareness-raising initiatives geared especially towards minors, with a view to providing clear information about harmful alcohol consumption, in order to promote informed choices and to help people better understand its effects on their health;
